description:
Convert a timestamp between two IANA timezones. Returns the wall-clock time in the target zone.

Returns: JSON { utc, zone, local } with the timestamp rendered in the target IANA timezone.
Example input: {"timestamp":"2026-07-11T12:00:00Z","to":"America/Los_Angeles"}
On error, includes hint: `timestamp` must be ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-07-11T12:00:00Z); `to` must be an IANA zone like America/New_York.
name: timezone_convert
title: Timezone converter
